steps.text: 7:17 P.M. \ Overcast
Abandoned Liquor Plant, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Get moving! Don't just stand there! Get a move on!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The general said we gotta be done with these materials tonight and get them sent to the station!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ungh...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What are you crying for? You slacking off?!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ahh... P-Please don't hit me... I haven't slept for three or four days now... I'm really tired... Agh!
Stop it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Who are you, and what gives you the right to stop me?!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Lady Heidi...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Don't worry, just get behind me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I see. You're the new girl who just got here a couple days ago. You're... a teacher? A journalist?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Whatever, don't remember exactly, but you're one of those good-for-nothing scumbags. A dime a dozen in Victoria.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Save the smooth talk for the rich and noble. It doesn't work on us Sarkaz!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough*.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Y-You're bleeding!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: If you want to kill me and my friends, then do it, but don't forget that there are some hundred pairs of eyes staring at you right now.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What are you all looking at?!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: They want to see how you're going to deal with me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You think we'd be scared of a bunch of prisoners?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Of course not, but work waits for no one. Isn't that right? You said it yourself. Your general wants these materials done tonight.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Heh, maybe seeing how you two is about to end up will motivate them some.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: If they figure out what awaits them tomorrow morning, do you think they'll still willingly spend their last night on Terra forging weapons for their enemies?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You...! How'd you know that tomorrow...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I also happen to know why you must let us live through the night.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hey, she's taunting you. Don't be a moron and spill all the beans. Let's get going. We have work to do too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I don't take orders from you!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: That change of clothes really helped your temper, huh? Remember who was crying for his mother when he was fighting the Victorian remnants not all that long ago.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Piss off, you loudmouthed merc. Your head's gonna roll one day because of that tongue of yours.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You'll have that jerk who's been yelling about everything in my ears to thank. Trust me, I didn't use to talk like this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'm too busy to be wasting time on you morons. Fine, I'll let these people live a couple hours longer.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: All of you... and you in particular. No funny moves.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Listen up! The Sarkaz got no tolerance for slackers! Anyone who's not working wins a date with our blades! Got it?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Now get to work, if you know what's good for you!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: We're safe for the time being.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I-I'm sorry, Lady Heidi. You got hurt because of me...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I'm fine. Just got my dress dirty.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: You're always so calm and graceful... It puts my mind at ease just knowing you're here with us.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Then trust me once more, alright?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Go back inside and stay with your friends. The Sarkaz still need you to do their work. They won't hurt us, for the time being.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: As for these mercenaries...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: We'd better stop watching. We got work to do tonight, right?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary B
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: Come on, no buts. Hoederer told us to come and do whatever the soldiers say.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: Okay, stop staring at the wall. This place is the farthest from the entrance. Not even a bug could fly in here. Look here—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary A
steps.text: —See how sturdy it is? Let's go.
7:27 P.M. \ Overcast
Underground structure, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Forward! Forward!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Report, Commander! The 3rd is all ready! Confirming Exit No. 9 clear—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Confirmed! We can exit safely!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, what are you doing here? You're still wounded...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain, permission to rejoin the team?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But the commander said...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: They have Bill. He covered me... and I can't just lie down here when I don't even know if he's still alive.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I will rescue him, Rockrock. I promise.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You might think I'm not a suitable leader...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If he was here, he would say that you are.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: He always believed in you. We all believe in you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You do...?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But this mission isn't like the covert rescue operations before.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We might run into a bunch of Sarkaz warriors head on and find ourselves in unprecedented danger.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, before you joined the Self-Salvation Corps, you were just the daughter of a train stoker who'd only graduated secondary school.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You're just a mechanic yourself.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha, that's true.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Sarkaz call us rebels... Does that really make us an army, though? We're just normal Londiniers.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You're absolutely right. I'm very normal.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I never remember all the righteous talk the commander preaches. The only thing on my mind is how to keep my family alive.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist, I'm actually really afraid of the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But I'm more afraid of you dying somewhere when I'm not looking!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know, Rockrock... I'm afraid too. I'm afraid of dying, and I'm even more afraid I could get the rest of you killed.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Phew... Haha.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It feels much better getting it off your chest, doesn't it?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Now, let's go.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Indra and I will guard this place with the Self-Salvation Corps. Dagda and Morgan are rendezvousing with Amiya.

options: It's not often you split up.
Did something happen?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There's no hiding anything from you, is there?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's nothing important. There are just certain things that we have to deal with sooner or later, and we needed a suitable time for them.

options: It's hard to push forward with expectations on your shoulders.
Need me to say anything to them?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Are you all ready?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You've just arrived at the exit closest to the objective. From here to the factory, we'll have to cross two underground blocks.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our squads are in position. They will make sure our trip to the objective goes smoothly.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I will leave you in command for the rest, Dr.{@nickname}.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Clovisia is a capable leader, and everyone has expectations of her and Amiya.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor, There's been a lot on my mind throughout this journey, but there is still one thing that I haven't entirely thought through.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If there is one thing I have to take care of myself, this is it. If I can't even keep my closest friends in check, then what's the point of coming back here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we got a transmission from Feist. They've made it aboveground already. We need to rendezvous with them right away—

options: It's time for us to leave.
Let's enjoy the Londinium air.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Right, we'll be ready.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Haha... I would like to know, too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I wish you... a safe journey.
7:55 P.M. \ Overcast
Outside the Eastern Entrance, Abandoned Liquor Plant, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake, give me a report of the situation up ahead.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: The path is clear, over.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Sniper team is in position.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. How many hostiles?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I got twelve in sight. All of them Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What about their commander? Do you see him?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Stay frosty. Wait for my signal.
8:09 P.M. \ Overcast
Abandoned Liquor Plant, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Aaah... ah...

steps.name: Anguished Man
steps.text: Ha... Haah... ah...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Benny, who's in that room?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Uh... the Self-Salvation Corps soldier they captured this afternoon.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Are they interrogating him?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: The Sarkaz won't let the chance to get some Self-Salvation Corps intel slip away. That soldier... probably doesn't have much longer to live.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I hope he'll hang in there for a little longer. It won't be much longer now...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Are they here...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No signs of anyone yet.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Then stay on the lookout.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How's Hoederer's search going?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The mercenaries are watching our prisoners in the cells. They've been working all day, but we have too many prisoners. It'll take time to check each one of them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's more, this guy we have in here is a stubborn one. We haven't managed to beat anything out of him...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hm... Make good use of what time we have left, then. If he still doesn't give us anything...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Is it my time to shine, then?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ugh—You, you...!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Put your blade down.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General! How did he...?!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Wait outside. I will take care of this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes... Please be careful!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: I'm sure you know that even if he actually tried to attack us, that blade wouldn't have done him much good.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Please... I would rather you stop startling my men. They're all fairly anxious as is.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Very well. We just didn't want to be late. Especially considering the guy inside isn't even breathing anymore.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You came at just the right moment, then.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Who's in charge of the south side of the factory?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Schwab's squad, Captain.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Schwab, huh...? He was in my squad five years ago.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Is that what you meant when you said I should pay attention to the shadows beneath my feet?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Get ahold of Schwab's position. No, have him come see me right now.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Benny, it's a little quiet outside the building, isn't it? Where are the mercenaries guarding the place? Are they gone?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Right, not one of them's still here.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: They are acting quite strange...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: They were strange to start with, no? The Sarkaz never made any sense, whether making friends or killing.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Don't say that unless you're trying to anger them.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Sorry, Lady Heidi... but I've been locked in here for two weeks. It's hard for me not to hate the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: No one blames you. You're doing very well.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Right, I heard the Sarkaz general paid us a visit at noon, with the mercenary leader.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Manfred did...?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Manfred... that's not good.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: This is a trap. Clovisia... and maybe them...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Are you worried that the commander will start the operation tonight? We need to find a way to get in touch with them... Uh... but it's been so many days, and we still haven't found a way to get any news past these walls.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: No, I'm sure they've considered that this could be a trap. This might perhaps... be an opportunity too.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Benny, let everyone know that our operation might need to be pushed up. Anyone who can fight should get ready to fight.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: But even if we can make it out of the factory building, it won't be easy to push through all the defenses outside the gate...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Then let's come this way.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: A mercenary told me this wall here... is very safe.
8:45 P.M. \ Overcast
Outside the South Wall of the Abandoned Liquor Plant, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Higher... A little higher... Yep, this is a nice view, stable and all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, what do you see?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm... Three entrances. Each of 'em have some thirty men standing guard.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The ones guarding the entrance to the east are all Sarkaz. So are the ones to the southwest, actually... Uh, different outfits, though. Looks like they might be mercs.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And there's the main entrance to the north... It's the Dublinn forces who're guarding that one.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then there are also some five or six squads patrolling the campus, going about between each factory building...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Wait up... The south... like, the wall closest to us... This place's empty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Empty?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Going by how things are laid out everywhere else, there should be a squad patrolling here, too... but there doesn't seem to be one.

options: Might be a trap.
Perhaps we have a helping hand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, should we proceed as planned?

options: What do you think?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to rescue Lady Heidi, and we also need to get to Central Londinium as soon as possible... No matter the case, we don't have any time to waste.

options: What about the Self-Salvation Corps?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: We'll do as you say in this operation. Commander's orders.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We have someone to rescue too.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, I was going to say that no matter what your call is, we've got our operation... but my brothers in the 3rd are right. You're the commander.

options: Alright, we'll proceed as planned.
Team Morgan, to the east entrance.
The 3rd will split up and distract the north and southwest entrances.
Closure will stay on surveillance and support.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Alright, Doctor. Dagda, let's go.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Roger that. Let's move!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No problem. Leave it to me.

options: Amiya, send a signal to the others.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Others? Are there other Rhodes Islanders aboveground?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, Mr. Feist. As soon as they get our signal, they'll know that we'll have an operation here tonight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you see them, Doctor? I'm guessing not yet, right? They aren't close enough.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You said they aren't nearby? Uh, does the Doctor have some kind of special Arts?

options: No, PRTS is helping me.
I've got X-ray vision.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What... That sounds like some amazing technology.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, you have to tell me more about it once we get back.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, you aren't pulling my leg, are you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You have to have some kind of special terminal. The kinds with displays and all!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But if someone is here, should we wait outside?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No need. If they determine there's a need to rendezvous with us, it'll be after we head inside.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Then the problem at hand is still how we get inside...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, it's your call. Which way?

options: Let's go south.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's a wall...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah! I get it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, Mr. Feist, do you have any way for us to climb over there?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We could blow it up? We made a buncha new demolition devices. Couldn't have blown Londinium's outer walls, but they could work here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Uh... it might be difficult.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Londinium's factories are usually built with reinforced outer walls. Unless you blow it up from the inside, it probably won't have as much of an effect as you'd expect.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then... How about if I pack in some more firepower?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, that'll attract too much attention. Morgan's efforts will go to waste.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright... I guess we should've had Morgan take some with her.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How about we use grappling hooks? Rockrock and I use them sometimes to hide from the patrols.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Johnny, bring the stuff over here.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: You got it, Captain. I almost thought I was carrying it for nothing.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Preparedness averts peril.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I need Rock-5 to mark the position...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, right, I almost forgot. Here!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is this... Rock-17? Why do you have it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Because I was working on it the whole time on our way up! Look, it's all done. It's got Closure's Seal of Quality on it!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh... I'm not sure my Seal of Quality is any good to you, though...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I checked it out. It's running well.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What's this ear?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I added it while I was at it! All Closure brand drones get one!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Crap... You don't like it? If you don't like it...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, no need to fix it.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Nothing wrong with the drone, then? I'll take the Doctor, Johnny, and Gabby with me. Rockrock... Can you take Amiya with you?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll launch the device, then—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-17, aim!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Anchor secured!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's do this, Miss Rockrock.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hold tight, Doctor. The wall isn't that tall, but they call these things ziplines for a reason.

options: So I'm not getting out of this, huh?
When do I get to be master of my own fate?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright... Are we all ready?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This might be our only chance—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 3, 2, 1—Launch!
